prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A dramatic, close-up view of jagged, dark rock formations, as if looking up from within a shadowy cave or crevice. The composition emphasizes the sharp, angular edges and textured surfaces of the rocks, with subtle variations in charcoal, slate, and deep blue-gray tones. Soft, diffused lighting creates gentle highlights along the ridges, accentuating the depth and complexity of the stone while leaving much of the scene in moody shadow. The background is blurred, enhancing the sense of depth and drawing focus to the intricate details of the foreground rocks. The overall style is cinematic and atmospheric, evoking a sense of mystery and natural grandeur, with a restrained, almost monochromatic color palette and a shallow depth of field that immerses the viewer in the raw, elemental beauty of the scene.
